description: G1: REAR Garden - Hornbeam x 2 prune and trim back height by 1/3 and sides by approx. 1m, prune to clear Arbor and Magnolia Kobus by 1m while leaving screening to neighbours windows.T2: REAR Garden - Magnolia Kobus very poorly pruned in the past. Remedial pruning to balance crown and remove stubs and poor pruning cuts.T3: REAR Garden - Hornbeam prune to clear Jasmine and wall by 1m, prune and trim back height by 1/3 and sides by approx. 1m.T4: REAR Garden - Neighbours Apple prune back to boundary.T5: REAR Garden - Liquidambar crown lift to 2m.G6: REAR Garden - Cornus x 3 prune back from seating area by 1-2m, crown lift over paved area by 2m, remove deadwood and water shoots.T7: REAR Garden - Hornbeam - prune and trim back height by 1/3 and sides by approx. 1m.TN8: REAR Garden - Neighbours Fig prune to clear building by 2m.
application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
borough: London Borough of Hammersmith and Fulham
